tagline: Six-voice saw and square synth with unison
description: A six-voice subtractive synth with a sawtooth and a square oscillator per voice, up to six detuned unison copies, a simple low-pass/high-pass filter and an ADSR envelope. Use it for basic leads, basses and pads.

features.name: Two oscillators
features.description: Saw and square, crossfaded by Osc Mix; the square can be detuned from -24 to +24 semitones.

features.name: Unison
features.description: 1 to 6 stacked copies per voice, spread across up to 50 cents.

features.name: Filter
features.description: One-pole (6 dB/octave) low-pass and high-pass, blended by LP/HP Mix, with cutoff from 20 Hz to 20 kHz.

features.name: ADSR envelope
features.description: Attack and decay up to 2 s, sustain level, release up to 5 s.

features.name: Output Level
features.description: -24 to +12 dB, ramped across each block to avoid clicks.
